ways.label: Tuohys Gully carpark to Lowburn

via.name: Lowburn Station farm gate
via.quote: Signage on a farm gate indicates the start of access through Lowburn Station

via.name: Ruins of an old stone cottage
via.quote: the ruins of an old stone cottage

evidence: From Tuohys Gully carpark, follow a 4WD track climbing steadily up to Tuohys Saddle (1,140 m).
At the top, follow the track to the left to descend 200 m to Meg Hut (960 m).
You then descend a 4WD road to the Deep Creek Hut (1,325 m).
Here you cross the Low Burn stream for one last uphill climb before crossing through farm paddock to the stile on Swann Road.

doubts: Start ref F1 (Meg Hut Pack Track meets Tuohys Gully Road) taken as the Tuohys Gully carpark, which the text puts at the end of a farm road in a small paddock. The end (stile on Swann Road / Lowburn carpark) has no matching feature. Lowburn carpark is the far end; listed as an access point since the page says there are carparks at either end, though it does not explicitly describe walking the track in reverse. Direction of description is Tuohys Gully to Lowburn.
